at: his riding boots beside the bed
alt: Small hours in the Kim house: old Seohyun under two quilts, gripping Yushin's sleeve; riding boots by the bed in the lamp's foreground
scene: Intimate low three-quarter from the floor beside one oil lamp set down by the bed: old Seohyun propped on a bolster, gripping his kneeling son's sleeve; Yushin in campaign blue, ear bent to his father's mouth; a pair of riding boots sharp in the foreground; the room's timber and paper doors falling into umber dark.

alt: An old ghost-king humming on the rock lip beside Yushin's fish sword, feet in the steaming water; Yushin turning chest-deep
scene: Over-the-shoulder from behind chest-deep Yushin (wet bare shoulder in foreground bokeh) in the black steam pool: on the rock lip an old man with a long beard in his lap, feet in the water, grinning, beside a ring-pommel sword and folded blue clothes; the three sisters tiny and quiet on the far rock.

at: the face in it isn’t quite his any more
alt: Yushin looks down into lacquer-still water; the reflection is an older face with a cone helm
scene: Straight down over Yushin's shoulder onto black lacquer-still water: his reflection has become an older bearded soldier's face with a Gaya cone helm, steam crossing it; the rock lip at the frame edge is empty except for the sword and wet footprints.

alt: Yushin, crying, throws his arms around his father's ghost and holds only steam; Muryuk behind, Golhwa turned to the wall
scene: Two-shot in the pool: Yushin lunging through the water, arms closing on a figure that is already steam; Seohyun barefoot in a white night-robe, hands half raised; Muryuk with the cone helm under his arm a step behind; far left, Golhwa turned to the rock wall.

at: A knee on the sword arm
alt: Worm's-eye from the mud: Bidam kneels on Yushin's sword arm, heavenly-horse blade point-down over his throat, prayer beads scattered
scene: Worm's-eye from the mud beside Yushin's head: scattered prayer beads sharp in the foreground; Bidam above him, knee on the sword arm, black headband, the ring-pommel blade raised point-down; storm sky with one break behind Bidam.

at: You are my son. You are Kim Yushin.
alt: RETAKE: the existing still shows Seohyun's hand on Yushin's jaw, but the ghost can no longer be touched; reshoot as a hand stopping a finger's width from his cheek
scene: Intimate ECU in the cavern: Seohyun's ghost hand stops a finger's width from Yushin's wet jaw, steam between them; Yushin's eyes full.
